title: (Deprecated) Supported filters
content_data:
You can use the following filters to narrow down the scope of reporting results. Please read the following notes before you start. - When passing multiple filters, the filter conditions have `AND` relationships. - When using `IN` filter type, `filter_value` needs to be a valid JSON list character string. > **Note**
> In asynchronous reservation ad reports, the only supported filter fields are `campaign_ids`, `adgroup_ids`, and `ad_ids`. # Supported filters ```xtable | Filter Field {15%} | Supported Filter Types {20%} | Supported Data Levels {20%} | Description {45%} | | ------------------- | ---------------------------- | --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | | campaign_ids | IN | Campaign/Ad group/Ad | Campaign ID, when using this filter, you can pass up to 100 campaign IDs. filter_value example: `"[123,456,789]"`. | | campaign_name | MATCH |Campaign | Campaign name. | | campaign_status | IN | Campaign/Ad group/Ad | Campaign status, optional: `NOTDELIVERY`, `DISABLE`, `DELIVERING`, `DELETE`. No filter indicates all states. | | adgroup_ids | IN | Ad group/Ad | Ad Group ID, when using this filter, you can pass up to 100 `adgroup_id`. | | adgroup_name | MATCH | Ad group | Ad Group Name. | | adgroup_status | IN | Ad group/Ad | Ad Group status, optional: `COMPLETE`, `FROZEN`, `DELIVERING`, `CLOSED`, `NOTDELIVERY`, `DELETE`. No filtering indicates all states. | | ad_ids | IN | Ad | Ad ID, when using this filter, you can pass up to 100 `ad_id`. | | ad_status | IN | Ad | Ad status, optional: `DELIVERING`, `NOT_DELIVERY`, `COMPLETE`, `DISABLE`, `DELETE`, `FROZEN`, `CLOSED`. No filtering indicates all states. | | app | IN | Ad group | Available products: `BUZZ_UP`, `SPICY`, `BABE`, `BABE_PLUS`, `TOP_BUZZ`, `NEWS_REPUBLIC`, `ULIKE`, `BUZZ_VIDEO`, `TIKTOK`. filter_value example: `[\" TIKTOK\, "\" BUZZVIDEO\ "]`. No filter means all products. | | billing_events | IN | Ad group | Billing method, optional `GD`, `CPT`. | | platform | IN | Ad group | Delivery platform, optional: `UNLIMITED`, `ANDROID`, `IOS`. | | locations | IN | Ad group | Countries or regions that you want to target. For enum values, see [Appendix - Location code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737585867307010). | | ad_placement | IN | Ad group | Ad placement. | | schedule_start_time | LESS_THAN/GREATER_THAN/RANGE | Ad group | Ad delivery start time(UTC+0). Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`. For example: `2021-01-01`. | | schedule_end_time | LESS_THAN/GREATER_THAN/RANGE |Ad group | Ad delivery end time(UTC+0). Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`. For example: `2021-01-01`. | ``` ## Examples To get ad groups that start delivery between 2021-04-01 and 2021-04-10, we can use the following filter: > {"field_name": "schedule_start_time", "filter_type": "RANGE", "filter_value": "[\"2021-04-01\", \"2021-04-10\"]"}
